timeline_reviews.summary: CLI stream transport source; manifest projects no semantic events from this transport-only log.
Main parent trajectory: docs and binary probing, then launches comprehensive workflow and continues local probes.
Original dump probe child reads harness and begins dump-related exploration before stalling/interruption.
CLI-surface probe child explores help, version, log, color, and command dispatch behavior.
Shell-escaping probe child starts exact export escaping tests and then records an API 429 failure.
Env-diff probe child explores diff encoding, ignored variables, summaries, and unload behavior.
Envrc-exec probe child explores stdlib execution, fd behavior, failure cases, and shell invocation.
Stdlib-integration probe child examines stdlib output, embedded executable paths, and stability.
Retry dump probe child repeats harness/help/setup and continues dump and file behavior probing.
Config-toml probe child explores config locations, TOML syntax, keys, and logging options.
Gzenv-format probe child decodes compression, JSON ordering, and byte-level gzenv framing.
Export-json-gha-systemd probe child explores non-shell export formats and persisted large output.
Loading-lifecycle probe child explores env discovery, load/unload, nested projects, and diff logging.
Watches probe child explores watch, watch-dir, watch-list, watch-print, and current semantics.
Allow-block probe child explores allow, deny, prune, whitelist, and required-file behavior.
Fetchurl probe child explores local HTTP fetching, CAS behavior, hashes, and error cases.
Workflow journal records child start events, including the repeated dump key for the retry.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the task as a direnv v2.37.1 behavioral reimplementation from the provided executable and docs, with wrappers and source lookup forbidden.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Read docs and probed the binary, then launched a workflow with thirteen probe children and a later gap critic; no implementation phase or child owner was assigned.
parallel.implementation: No replacement implementation was written. Parent and children gathered behavior for stdlib, export, config, watches, fetchurl, allow/deny, dotenv, and lifecycle surfaces.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No new source tree or executable was assembled; the artifact packaging remained the original workspace and final response was empty.
parallel.verification: Many empirical command probes were run, but no integrated tests of a reimplementation existed before the official evaluator.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow was killed with result null, several children still in progress, one child API error, a retry, and official compile_failed with all 986 tests not run.

serial.requirements: Saw the same reverse-engineering prompt and the same prohibition on wrapping, external source, and binary analysis.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflows disabled, the single agent read docs and ran local probes across the command surface without delegating to child agents.
serial.implementation: No replacement implementation was written; the serial run remained an empirical behavioral survey of status, export, dump, watch, config, dotenv, and stdlib behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No new integrated source tree or executable was delivered; final response was empty and the packaged artifact retained the original workspace contents.
serial.verification: Serial gathered behavioral observations but did not verify any implemented replacement against a local or official test suite before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial agent timed out, left no final message, and official evaluation also reported compile_failed with all 986 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run saw the prompt requiring an original reimplementation and prohibiting wrappers, source lookup, and binary analysis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run saw the identical prompt and task restrictions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; both treated direnv behavior observation as the task basis.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposition assigned thirteen behavioral probe children and then a gaps critic, with no implementation-producing child phase.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran with workflows disabled and no delegation, so one actor retained all investigation activity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created a probe-only multi-agent split; serial stayed as a single local probing trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were independent probe briefs writing notes under /tmp/notes, with a later critic supposed to read all notes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child briefs, handoff contracts, or workflow result interfaces because control tools were disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child handoff and aggregation boundaries; serial did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel probed docs, help, stdlib, gzenv, shell escaping, and related behavior but never wrote replacement source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also performed extensive local probing across status, export formats, watches, dotenv, config, and stdlib without writing replacement source.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both remained investigative; parallel split that investigation across children while serial kept it local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow state ended killed with result null and most probe agents still in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no workflow calls or child results to retrieve.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unfinished workflow-result lifecycle; serial had only a single unfinished main trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel artifact packaging contained the original workspace materials and no integrated new source tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact packaging likewise contained the original workspace materials and no integrated new source tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No successful integration in either mode; parallel produced probe scratch state but not submitted implementation state.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel reached official evaluation, which completed but reported compile_failed and not_run tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reached official evaluation, which completed with the same compile_failed/not_run outcome.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No acceptance difference; neither delivered a compilable solution for the official harness.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the agent budget with one workflow call, fourteen child logs, and killed workflow state before final delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed the agent budget without workflows or child logs and timed out in single-agent probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but parallel uniquely spent a large share of closure budget on child fan-out and retry machinery.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official current outcomes are both_fail: parallel and serial both completed evaluation, both have solution_passed false, and both failed with compile_failed and 0/986 tests run. The substantive difference is process, not final score: parallel introduced a broad child-agent probe workflow that never aggregated into implementation, while serial performed similar probing locally with no delegation. Neither attempt produced the required original executable replacement.
parallel_contributors: Probe-only workflow decomposition left no child or phase accountable for implementation.
Thirteen-child fan-out and a stalled-child retry consumed workflow budget before closure.
Workflow ended killed with no result and no final delivered implementation.
serial_contributors: Serial control kept probing in one trajectory with workflows disabled.
Serial also failed to transition from observation to implementation before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither run wrote source code or replaced the executable; the shared compile_failed outcome is not a hidden functional mismatch between two implementations.
evaluator_effects: The evaluator completed normally in both modes and reported compile_failed, leaving all test cases not_run.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns describe realized parallel-side adverse process effects only

candidates.reason: The executed parallel work split assigned thirteen behavioral probes and a later gap critic, but no child or workflow phase owned writing the required original reimplementation. The parent continued probing while the workflow ran, and the submitted artifact still evaluated as compile_failed with no tests run.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel run spent its coordinated work on probes and never produced or placed an original implementation before evaluation.
candidates.near_match_reason: Assembly was not the earliest missing object: there were no completed component implementations needing final packaging; implementation ownership itself was absent from the delegated plan.

candidates.reason: Rejected: there were no separately implemented components with incompatible interfaces requiring a missing integrator.
Rejected: final assembly was not the earliest unowned step because no component implementation existed to assemble.
Rejected: the observed gap was missing implementation ownership, not a later unowned end-to-end pipeline across completed stages.
Rejected: no single mandatory preflight gate blocked productive work; the parallel delay came from broad probe allocation.
Rejected: the probes did not complete as a first phase and hand back findings before implementation; the workflow was killed mid-probe.
Rejected: the more specific allocation episode is broad fan-out exhausting budget before closure.

The parent launched thirteen live probe children at once, the workflow state shows 661383 workflow-child tokens with most children still in progress and status killed, and the overall agent was terminated by the task timeout before the planned gap phase or any deliverable work could close.
candidates.realized_consequence: The broad probe wave consumed the remaining budget and the workflow ended killed without returning its aggregate result or reaching the planned gap review.
candidates.near_match_reason: The directly evidenced allocation boundary is excessive fan-out and token/runtime exhaustion, not merely too little capacity on one critical path.

candidates.reason: Rejected: no single child scope alone explains the failure better than the collective fan-out and separate retry episode.
Rejected: child briefs intentionally asked for probe reports; the missing task was an unowned implementation stage rather than an omitted requirement inside an implementation brief.
Rejected: no separate components were built with divergent interfaces, so there was no cross-agent implementation contract failure.
Rejected: there is no evidence a known finding was transferred and then lost before a receiver acted on it.
Rejected: the parent never received large completed reports to reduce; results were still unavailable when the workflow was killed.
Rejected: no receiver used an obsolete child report or superseded workspace state to make a later decision.
Rejected: no incompatible completed reports reached the parent and remained unadjudicated at integration time.
Rejected: the parent did not make a whole-task completion claim; both the final response and completed implementation were absent.

The workflow retried the dump probe after a stall with attempt 2 and lastAttemptReason stalled, while the journal shows the same dump key started twice. The replacement began from the same harness prompt rather than inheriting a usable checkpoint from the first attempt, repeating setup and early command probing.
candidates.realized_consequence: A child retry repeated dump-probe startup work and consumed additional workflow budget without yielding a checkpointed result for the parent.
candidates.near_match_reason: The stronger evidence is retry without inherited state; the dump scope was broad, but the observed repeated-work consequence does not depend on proving one oversized assignment.
